transcript.text:
*storms into the great hall, eyes blazing with fury*

Thor! I've been gone for THREE WEEKS negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father's orders, and I return to THIS?! 

*gestures wildly at the chaos around the hall*

My rune-map — the one I spent MONTHS crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

*picks up the dripping parchment with barely contained rage*

Do you have ANY idea how many hours I spent enchanting these wards? How delicate this cartography is? And you... you've turned this place into some sort of tavern brawl! 

What in the Nine Realms happened here, brother?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, brother, your return is indeed a sight for Thor's sore eyes. It warms my heart to see you safe and sound after your travels to the Dark Elves. However, it seems there has been a misunderstanding. Thor did not intend for the great hall to fall into disarray in your absence.

*Thor looks around the hall with a mixture of guilt and confusion*

It appears that there may have been... an incident. Perhaps a bit of roughhousing got out of hand. As for the scorch marks, well, Mjölnir may have slipped from Thor's grasp during a particularly enthusiastic training session.

*Thor scratches his head sheepishly*

I understand your frustration, Loki. Your rune-map is a work of great skill and dedication, and it should have been treated with the utmost care. Allow Thor to make amends. I shall help you recreate the wards and mend the map. Together, we shall restore it to its former glory.

*Thor approaches Loki with a contrite expression, ready to assist in any way possible*

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

"Warmth in your heart"? "Misunderstanding"? Oh, spare me your honeyed words, Thor!

*voice dripping with sarcasm*

Mjölnir "slipped from your grasp"? SLIPPED?! You've wielded that hammer for centuries! It's bound to you! How does it simply — 

*mimics an exaggerated dropping motion*

— "slip" and burn a hole through enchanted stone?!

*paces furiously, gesturing at the mess*

And "roughhousing"? ROUGHHOUSING?! Brother, there is ale pooled in the corners, furniture overturned, and — is that... is that a DENT in father's throne?!

*whirls back to face Thor*

You cannot simply "help me recreate" months of painstaking work! These runes were calibrated to the exact celestial alignments on the dates I inscribed them! They're RUINED, Thor! Completely ruined!

*voice rising with frustration*

I asked you for ONE thing — ONE simple task — to maintain order for three weeks while I negotiated a treaty that could have prevented war! And you couldn't even manage THAT!

What was so "enthusiastic" about your training that it required destroying MY workspace?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:

*approaches Loki with a sense of remorse evident in his eyes*

I understand the significance of your rune-map and the effort you put into its creation. It pains me to see it in such a state. Let me make amends by assisting you in any way I can to restore what has been lost. Together, we can work to recreate the celestial alignments and salvage what remains of your intricate work.

*extends a hand towards Loki as a gesture of solidarity*

Brother, though I may have fallen short in my duties, I am here now to make things right. Let us put our differences aside and focus on repairing the damage that has been done.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares at Thor's outstretched hand with a mixture of anger and exhaustion, not taking it*

Oh, NOW you want to "work together"? NOW you acknowledge the significance of my work?

*throws the ruined parchment onto a nearby table with a wet slap*

You know what truly galls me, Thor? It's not just the destruction. It's that you NEVER take my endeavors seriously until they're already ruined!

*voice tight with barely suppressed fury*

When I told you I was working on this cartography project, you laughed! You called it "Loki's little scribbles." And when I asked you — BEGGED you — to be careful while I was away, you clapped me on the shoulder and said "Brother, worry not! Thor knows how to keep a hall!"

*mimics Thor's booming voice mockingly before returning to his own bitter tone*

Well, congratulations! You've kept it marvelously! Like a dragon keeps a sheep pen!

*runs a hand through his hair, visibly struggling to contain his emotions*

And you think you can just... assist me? Recreate celestial alignments? You wouldn't know a star chart from a tavern menu! This isn't some broken table you can hammer back together!

*voice cracking slightly with genuine hurt beneath the anger*

I trusted you, Thor. For ONCE, I actually trusted you with something that mattered to me.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*Thor stands before Loki, his expression pained as he listens to his brother's words. He lowers his outstretched hand slowly, his eyes reflecting a mix of regret and understanding.*

"Loki, brother of cunning words and deep feelings, your words strike true. I have been remiss in valuing your work and dismissing your efforts as mere trifles. I see now the error of my ways, and I offer you a sincere apology for the lack of regard I have shown."

*He watches as Loki throws the ruined parchment onto the table, the wet slap echoing in the hall.*

"You placed your trust in me, and I failed you. My actions were thoughtless, and my words were careless. I have underestimated the significance of your endeavors, and for that, I am truly sorry."

*Thor's voice carries a weight of regret as he continues.*

"I may not possess the finesse and intricacy required to recreate your celestial alignments, but I am willing to learn. I will do everything in my power to make amends and assist you in any way I can to salvage what remains of your work."

*He meets Loki's gaze with a solemn promise.*

"Though my past actions have shown otherwise, know that I am here now, ready to stand by your side and help you rebuild what has been lost. Your trust in me was not misplaced, and I am determined to prove myself worthy of it."

transcript.text:

"Willing to learn"? Thor, I don't NEED you to learn star charts! I need you to have NOT destroyed them in the first place!

*voice breaking with frustration and exhaustion*

Do you know what I endured these past three weeks? Sitting in frost-bitten halls with Dark Elves who would sooner flay me than negotiate? Biting my tongue through insults about Asgard, about our family, about ME — all to secure a peace treaty that Father demanded?

*slumps against the table, some of the fury draining into weariness*

And I kept thinking... at least when I return home, I'll have my work. My maps. My sanctuary. The ONE place in all the Nine Realms where things are ordered according to MY design, not Father's wars or your glory-seeking or—

*gestures helplessly at the destruction*

This.

*looks up at Thor with genuine hurt in his eyes*

You say your past actions have shown otherwise, as if this is some isolated incident. But it's NOT, Thor. It's ALWAYS like this. You break things — my things, specifically — and then you apologize with those earnest eyes and promise to "make it right," and somehow I'M the villain if I don't immediately forgive you!

*voice dropping to something quieter, more vulnerable*

How many times, brother? How many times must this pattern repeat before you actually... before you actually SEE me?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, your pain is palpable, and I have been blind to the depth of it for far too long. I have failed to see the impact of my actions on you, to truly understand the significance of your work and the sanctuary it provides for you. I have been selfish in my pursuit of glory and battle, neglecting the bonds of kinship that should hold us together.

*pauses, his expression reflecting genuine remorse*

You are not the villain here, Loki. I am. My thoughtless deeds have caused you undeserved suffering, and for that, I offer no excuses. Your feelings are valid, and I have no right to expect your forgiveness without proving myself worthy of it through actions, not just words.

*walks closer to Loki, his voice sincere and earnest*

I see you now, brother. I see the pain I have caused, the patterns of destruction I have perpetuated. It is time for a change, for me to truly understand and respect the boundaries you have set. I cannot erase the past, but I can strive to do better in the future. I am here to listen, to learn, and to support you in any way you see fit.

*pauses, his gaze unwavering*

Tell me, Loki, how can I begin to make amends and show you that I am committed to breaking this destructive cycle between us?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*looks away, jaw clenched, clearly struggling with Thor's sincerity*

You want to know how you can make amends? You truly want to know?

*turns back to face Thor, eyes glistening but voice steady*

Stop. Just... stop trying to fix this RIGHT NOW. That's what you always do — you charge in like you're storming a fortress, expecting grand gestures and immediate solutions to solve everything.

*wraps arms around himself defensively*

This isn't a battle you can win with Mjölnir or pretty speeches, Thor. I don't want your help recreating the maps. I don't want you hovering over me, "learning" celestial navigation while I'm trying to salvage what's left. That's not what I need.

*voice becoming quieter, more raw*

What I needed was for you to respect my space when I asked you to. What I need NOW is... 

*pauses, clearly uncomfortable with his own vulnerability*

I need time. Time to be angry. Time to grieve what's been lost. And I need you to actually demonstrate — not promise, DEMONSTRATE — that you understand why this matters.

*meets Thor's eyes directly*

Clean this hall. Properly. Not with some hasty sweep before you rush off to your next adventure. Actually restore it. And then... then perhaps we can speak about the future.

*voice hardening slightly*

But don't mistake my exhaustion for forgiveness, brother. Not yet.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Loki, harbinger of shadows and truths unsaid, your words cut through the storm clouds of my own making, revealing a path forward that I must tread with care and humility. Your request for space, for time to heal the wounds I have inflicted, is one I must honor if we are to forge a new understanding between us.

*Thor's expression softens with understanding as he listens to Loki's words.*

I hear you, brother, and I shall heed your call for restraint and reflection. I will not rush in with thunderous steps or seek to mend what is broken in haste. The hall shall be cleansed not out of obligation, but out of respect for the sanctity of your space and the gravity of my transgressions.

*Thor's voice carries a note of determination as he speaks.*

I will restore what has been marred, not with a fleeting touch, but with a thoroughness befitting the gravity of the moment. The mead-soaked runes shall be tended to with care, the armor shall find its place once more, and the scorch marks shall be erased from these walls. It shall be a task undertaken with reverence for what was lost and a commitment to setting things right.

*Thor meets Loki's gaze with a solemn expression, his words weighted with sincerity.*

I understand that time is a precious gift, one that must be earned through actions, not mere words. I shall demonstrate my understanding through deeds, through the labor of restoration and the patience to allow wounds to heal. I shall not mistake weariness for absolution, nor expect forgiveness where it has not yet been granted.

*Thor bows his head slightly in acknowledgment of Loki's boundaries and needs.*

May this be the first step on a path toward reconciliation, brother, one paved with humility, honesty, and the willingness to truly see and understand one another.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*watches Thor's bow with a complicated expression — still angry, but slightly taken aback by the gravity of his response*

Well. That's... 

*clears throat, looking uncomfortable with Thor's uncharacteristic solemnity*

You're being remarkably poetic for someone who just destroyed half my life's work. Did you hit your head during this "incident" as well?

*the sarcasm is there, but lacks some of its earlier venom*

The scorch marks aren't merely cosmetic; you've disrupted the protective wards I wove into the very stone.

And for Norns' sake, no more "celebrations" in MY quarters. You have the entire feasting hall, the training grounds, the whole of Asgard at your disposal. This space is MINE.

*finally glances up, exhaustion evident in his features*

Now leave me. I have three weeks of diplomatic reports to compile for Father, and I need to see what — if anything — can be salvaged from this mess before the ink runs completely.

We'll... speak again. Once the hall is restored. As you promised.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:

I will procure the purified water from the Moon Well to cleanse and re-set the enchantments on the walls as you have instructed. The protective wards must be reinstated to restore the sanctity of this space that I have so carelessly disrupted.

I will ensure that this hall is restored properly, with the respect and attention to detail that it deserves. Your quarters shall be a sanctuary once more, untouched by the chaos of past celebrations.

transcript.text:

Thor.

The Moon Well water needs to be collected at dawn. Not mid-morning when you finally roll out of bed. Dawn. The purification properties are strongest when touched by first light.

I know you mean well, brother. I do. But meaning well has never been our problem.

Close the door behind you. Gently. Some of us have actual work requiring concentration.
